title: Failed native-browser reconnect loses rollback and releases attached ownership during in-flight shutdown
causalEvidence: Two original-source regressions admit another reconnect without retained cleanup or release the attached reservation while reconnect rollback is unconfirmed. The unchanged application replay rejects the complete B398 package. Private observation around that old graph proves one extra process grant and real Worker after each completion/termination failure, with the original termination-failed Worker still alive, and releases the reservation on in-flight disposal despite unfinished accounting.
